topic: Why Bitcoin proof of work is hard to fake
hook: Bitcoin mining is hard to do, but easy to check.

scenes.narration: Finding a block means searching for a header hash below the target. There's no shortcut except more guesses.
Once a block is found, other nodes can check its proof of work cheaply.
Honest checking is cheap, while cheating would take enormous computing work.

cta: Want to dig deeper? There's a link on my channel page if you'd like to explore digital mining.
title: Why Bitcoin Mining Is Hard to Fake
description_body: Proof of work is expensive to produce and cheap to verify, which is what protects the network.
